rational_homology_datum.hermitian_convention: H is K-linear in the first variable and conjugate-linear in the second
rational_homology_datum.integrality_note: For x,y in Z[i]^6, H(x,y) is in Z[i] and Tr(i H(x,y)) is an even integer; E is integral and nondegenerate.
rational_homology_datum.riemann_domain: The compatible complex structures form the nonempty U(3,3)/(U(3)xU(3)) domain; E(x,Jx)>0 on the standard base point and hence on its connected component.

fine_moduli_instantiation.level: full level 3 (used only to obtain a fine PEL moduli cover)
fine_moduli_instantiation.component: S_{-3}: connected PEL unitary component determined by (K,Lambda,H) and level 3
fine_moduli_instantiation.point: eta = a geometric generic point of S_{-3}; fix an embedding of its algebraically closed residue field into C and base-change the universal abelian scheme to obtain A_eta/C.
fine_moduli_instantiation.genericity: eta is fixed before any cycle search and lies outside every proper closed/special locus not equal to the whole component.
fine_moduli_instantiation.reason_for_generic_model: avoids selecting a decomposable/CM/special positive-control point merely because a known cycle exists.

norm_separation.certificate: For Q(i), every rational norm has even valuation at primes p == 3 mod 4. v_3(3)=1 is odd.

discriminant.also_not_trivial: [-3] != [1] because norms from Q(i) are positive while -3 is negative.

carrier_dimension_proof: wedge_K^6 of a K-vector space of dimension 6 is one-dimensional over K.
hodge_typing_proof: After tensoring with C, K has the two embeddings sigma and conjugate-sigma and the determinant carrier splits into two complex determinant lines.
The Weil multiplicity condition gives dimensions (3,3) for the (1,0)/(0,1) pieces in each embedding component.
Therefore each determinant line has Hodge bidegree (3,3), so W_K(A_eta) is contained in H^{3,3}(A_eta).

divisor_algebra_control.source_supported_exceptionality: The selected generic Weil-type scope retains the exceptional Weil subspace; it is not replaced by the single theta^3 divisor line.
divisor_algebra_control.firewall: No divisor-product class is accepted as a generator for W_K(A_eta).

frontier_exclusion.known_Q_sqrt_minus_3_trivial_sixfold_res: not applicable because K=Q(i) and discriminant class is nontrivial
